# MDFN

> Markdown-native authoring with source preservation, safe rendering, and collaboration.

## Documentation

- [Collaboration](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mdfn/docs/content/docs/collaboration.md) — Exchange authorized Yjs updates and compact exact batches.
- [Extensions and profiles](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mdfn/docs/content/docs/extensions.md) — Resolve syntax ownership, conflicts, and migrations.
- [Framework editors](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mdfn/docs/content/docs/framework-editors.md) — Install and mount a controller in React, Svelte, Solid, or the vanilla DOM.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mdfn/docs/content/docs/getting-started.md) — Install MDFN, edit Markdown, observe changes, and release the controller.
- [MDFN](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mdfn/docs/content/docs/index.md) — Markdown-native authoring with a durable source contract.
- [Integrations](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mdfn/docs/content/docs/integrations.md) — Connect assets, search, content, and AI through explicit bridges.

- [Verification](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mdfn/docs/content/docs/verification.md) — Run the consumer and browser gates for an MDFN integration.
